title: Hoolie drops an infectious future bass soundtrack with “Easy To Love”
htmlContent: Hoolie's latest single, "Easy To Love," is a vibrant, electrifying burst of future bass and riddim that brings listeners into a universe of high energy and sheer delight. You can hear that this track was made with joy, radiating off every second of this journey. Hoolie's love of crafting songs that make you dance and feel the music shines through in the playful melodies and future bass feel to "Easy To Love." This song is a track made to get you moving, and it is a fitting soundtrack for the dance floor or the living room. The riddim components provide texture, adding in that signature bounce that belongs right alongside the meal ticket genre fans seek it out. The strongest feeling one takes from "Easy To Love" is its unassuming charm. The vibe, how lively and approachable it feels. Hoolie pulls off making a high-energy tune while also keeping it accessible, which is something the bass music heads and the new listeners of the genre can jam out to. The new single demonstrates Hoolie's expert ability to merge styles together without losing coherence. The future bass shines through the sparkling synth work and infectious hooks, and the riddim influence brings his characteristically bouncy, grimy sensibility to the table, providing an impassioned groove that feels just right. https://open.spotify.com/track/6CLNa30Rzc3GvCWmzP5020 This merging once again emphasizes Hoolie's versatility and passion for breaking genre borders yet still holding the audience by the hand. "Easy To Love" exudes a joyous, celebratory sense of the sound, of creation, of the sheer pleasure of making music. It's a reminder that the best tracks often result from artists just having fun in the studio. And that energy is completely contagious. Hoolie's "Easy To Love" is pristinely produced and genuinely driven by spirit. If you need an upbeat and heartfelt song, this single is your new favorite.
